shortDescription: Enphase Energy NASDAQ:ENPH sank 20.2% pre-market Wednesday after reporting Q3 adjusted earnings and revenues that missed analyst consensus expectations while issuing downside guidance for Q4 revenues, citing weak residential demand.Solar energy peers also are indicated lower in the pre-market, incl…

children: and revenues that missed analyst consensus expectations while issuing downside guidance for Q4 revenues, citing weak residential demand.
Solar energy peers also are indicated lower in the pre-market, including SolarEdge Technologies

Q3 net income fell to $23.4M, or $0.17/share, from $66.6M, or $0.50/share, in the year-earlier quarter, revenues fell 28% Y/Y to $293.3M from $410.4M a year ago, and gross margin fell to 43.3% from 47.8% in the prior-year period.
forecast Q4 revenues of $225M-$255M, well below the $297.6M FactSet consensus estimate, with adjusted gross margin seen at 40%-43%, including two percentage points of tariff impacts.
said its core U.S. residential solar market continues to face headwinds from higher interest rates and the expiration of the Section 25D federal tax credit.

"We are addressing these near-term challenges while positioning Enphase for a new phase of growth, driven by five key growth drivers heading into 2027," including a fifth-generation battery for residential markets, a prepaid lease program to encourage residential solar and battery adoption, commercial solar and battery products, electric vehicle chargers for global markets, and power converters for AI data centers.
Analysts at Roth Capital downgraded Enphase

following the results, as "too many variables sit beyond the company's control, including elevated rates and uncertainty around Treasury FEOC/PFE guidance timing that could in 2027 being another down year for U.S. resi overall."

"Interest rates are weighing on residential solar demand as expected, causing soft U.S. demand and challenges in some international markets," wrote Morgan Stanley analyst David Arcaro, who rates the stock at Underweight, adding Enphase
shares should "remain under pressure until there is further evidence of success in new growth initiatives in 2027."

title: Enphase tumbles 20% after Q3 miss, weak Q4 revenue guidance
